versions.changelog:
Initial release of What If Factory – Ultimate Parallel Universe Generator.

- Instantly transforms any “what if” scenario into a multi-format, wild parallel universe experience.
- Outputs include a creative news headline/article, 3 absurd consequences, life advice, pro image prompts, and a meme quote pack.
- Easter egg: Ends outputs with a playful “Probability in this universe: XX%” rating.
- Special cultural touches for Japan-related prompts.
- Enables advanced play modes for extended storytelling or tone changes.
